Messages.Author: L. Scott Johnson
Messages.Body:
In article <Pine.A32.3.91.960523...@cymbal.aix.calpoly.edu>,

Everett Littles <elit...@cymbal.aix.calpoly.edu> wrote:
>If the minion being affected by Jar The Soul has no blood on him and the
>acting minion as superior does the affected minion go into torpor?

No. You only go to torpor if you take damage you can't heal, or if a card
effects specifically says you go to torpor (Day Op., Legacy of Power, etc.)

A standard 'burn blood' effect will have no effect on an empty vampire.
This includes Cryptic missions and Jars of Souls.

Messages.Author: Ethan Burrow
Messages.Body:
Everett Littles <elit...@cymbal.aix.calpoly.edu> wrote:

> If the minion being affected by Jar The Soul has no blood on him and the
> acting minion as superior does the affected minion go into torpor?

No, the affected vampire just "fails" to burn a blood.
